title: Proxy Hijack
description: Inject rerouting packets into the network's switching gateway.

hints: The beginning of the code is the number of A/C vents in the stairwell leading upstairs.
The middle of the code is the number of A/C vents upstairs excluding closets and the stairwell.
The end of the code is the number of A/C vents on the main floor.

config.instruction: Redirection tables stabilized. Download the firewall ruleset, or cash in an ISP infrastructure credit.
